// diagnostic

E0135

A compile-time literal outside a range type's declared bounds (D-RANGETYPE1)

What

A compile-time literal outside a range type's declared bounds (D-RANGETYPE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0135

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0135: tests/ui/inline_range_out_of_bounds.stderr.

Error [E0135]: `150` is outside `Int(0..100)`'s range 0..100
  --> tests/ui/inline_range_out_of_bounds.jet:3:27
    |
  3 | fn run() { set_brightness(150) }
    |                           ^^^
 Why: a range type only holds values inside its bounds; `150` can never be an `Int(0..100)`
 Fix: use a value in `0..100`, or widen the type's range
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0135
